acceptance_criteria: unmapped/out-of-tolerance and no-authority-call matrix; CHK-09, NEG-11, NEG-12.
statement: When the matrix exercises clock resolution, an absent, unmapped, or out-of-tolerance resolved time **shall** fail closed before emission and before journaling intent; an immediate request **shall** be explicitly labeled; and the action path and lease registry **shall never** compare or order two raw mismatched clock domains and **shall** call no time authority.
title: T029 requirement 008
